explanation: The offensive's own lead makes the junta one of its two parties and dates that junta to the coup: "The offensive was part of a renewed conflict between the Malian junta that took power in 2021 and former Tuareg rebel groups that had signed the Algiers Agreement in 2015." § Background works the same ground: the CSP-PSD formed in April 2021, "just a month later" Goïta's coup took power, and "Goita and the CSP-PSD got off to a rocky start". Precondition and not cause: the article says the coup made the two parties what they were, not that it ordered the convoy north. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
